prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a close-up, highly detailed photograph focusing on a section of a light gray or off-white technical fabric, such as a high-performance jacket. The fabric should have a slightly crinkled, water-resistant texture, with subtle reflections and a soft, matte finish. Prominently featured in the center of the frame is a minimalist, modern black logo consisting of the letters "o" and "n" in a clean, sans-serif font, oriented vertically. The lighting is diffuse and cool, evoking an overcast or misty outdoor environment, with gentle shadows that emphasize the texture of the material. The composition is tight and intimate, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and edges, drawing attention to the logo and the tactile quality of the fabric. The overall mood is sleek, contemporary, and understated, with a focus on technical detail and subtle branding.
